_comment: The Open Finance obligations Meridian Trust meets in Define (docs/plans/kosli-founder-demo-briefing.md, 'The Open Finance obligations Meridian meets in Define'). FICTIONAL PLANNING material for the demo: the sources are named, the articles are deliberately NOT cited — every `article` says so, because regulatory clauses are load-bearing and are never paraphrased from memory into a register (CLAUDE.md). Before the meeting, verify each against the current Regulation and Standards with the open-finance-uae skill and replace the article text. run-demo.mjs --scenario meridian appends `register` rows to the data-risk register and `obligations` to the obligations register in the adopted tree; the discovery run's data-governance.md cites these ids (D6). None of this touches the shipped templates.

taxonomy.definition: Risk that data received from another institution under a customer's consent is used beyond the consented scope or purpose, retained past expiry, or used after the customer has withdrawn consent.

Risk that the institution's participation on the national Open Finance platform, as data recipient or payment initiator, fails conformance or certification, or that the platform dependency is not governed as a critical third-party service.

statements.statement: Account and transaction data received from another bank is displayed, retained or processed outside the scope, purpose or duration the customer consented to, or after revocation.
regulatory_drivers: CBUAE Open Finance Regulation (consent provisions — verify)

statements.statement: Meridian exposes a customer journey that depends on the national platform and other participants before its own conformance is certified, or without treating the platform as a governed critical dependency.

controls.control_owner: First line — product, with data protection
controls.description: Received data is bound to a consent record carrying scope, purpose and expiry; use outside the record is refused; revocation is honoured before the next use and evidenced.

controls.control_owner: First line — platform, with information security and operations
controls.description: No customer exposure of an Open Finance journey before functional, security and customer-experience certification evidence exists for the role exercised; the platform dependency carries a resilience assessment and an outsourcing register entry.

conditions: consent journey has a named owner before prototyping with any received data
revocation evidenced in the negative test
certification evidence for the data-recipient role before pilot
platform dependency on the outsourcing register before pilot

obligations.article: Participation and licensing provisions for a licensed financial institution acting as data provider and, separately, as a data recipient or payment initiator. Article to be verified against the current Regulation before citation; deliberately not quoted from memory.
obligations.title: Meridian participates on the national Open Finance platform in each role it exercises — data provider today, data recipient for this proposition — under the participation requirements of that role, with the roles' obligations kept distinct

obligations.source: CBUAE Open Finance Regulation and UAE Open Finance Standards — consent
obligations.article: Consent capture, scope, duration, revocation and customer visibility provisions, and the AlTareq customer-experience rules for consent screens. Article and Standards section to be verified before citation; deliberately not quoted from memory.
obligations.title: Data from another bank is received and used only under a customer consent that is scoped, purpose-bound, time-limited, visible to the customer and revocable, and revocation is honoured

obligations.article: Lawful basis, purpose limitation, data minimisation and retention provisions as they apply to account and transaction data received from another institution. Article to be verified before citation; deliberately not quoted from memory.
obligations.title: Received account and transaction data is processed on a lawful basis, for the consented purpose only, minimised to the proposition, retained no longer than the consent, and never present in non-production artifacts

obligations.source: UAE Open Finance Standards — security profile and certification
obligations.article: Security profile conformance (FAPI-grade profile, mutual TLS), the Standards version in force, and the functional, security and customer-experience certification and live-proving steps for the role exercised. Section to be verified before citation; deliberately not quoted from memory.
obligations.title: No customer exposure of an Open Finance journey before Meridian's implementation of the exercised role is certified against the Standards version in force

obligations.article: Critical third-party dependency, incident and availability provisions as they apply to the national platform dependency. Requirement to be verified before citation; deliberately not quoted from memory.
obligations.title: The national platform is governed as a critical dependency: resilience assessed, incidents and availability managed, and the dependency recorded on the outsourcing register
